'''Freefloater desks''' were a make of desk which was considered fashionable in [[43 ABY]]. In this [[Standard year/Legends|year]] the [[Judge/Legends|judge]], [[Arabelle Lorteli]] had one in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Arabelle Lorteli's office|office]], which [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] noted was bereft of paperwork, [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] or even a reading [[Lamp/Legends|lamp]] when [[Gender/Legends|he]] was in the room to observe the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]] of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]]. The aesthetically pleasing but relatively unused desk, along with several other objects, led him to the conclusion that the office was designed with fashion, instead of function, in mind.<ref name="Ab" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Freefloater desk first appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' which was written by [[Troy Denning]] as the third instalment of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
